Subject: Ops owners rollcall: QBR + OKR gate for Project Atlas

Team —

This thread is the single-source rollcall for the Project Atlas QBR check (next Tues) and the related OKR gate. We need a clear status signal by EOD Monday so leadership can finalize the QBR narrative. High-level asks: 

1) GTM & pricing: confirm final price bands and any discount guardrails.
2) Enablement: confirm training materials, playbooks, and readiness date for CS and AMs.
3) Docs: list of public-facing docs and internal runbooks that will be updated and owners.
4) Support readiness: escalation paths, SLO adjustments, on-call coverage windows for launch week.

Please respond with the one-line status (Green/Amber/Red), owner, eta, and one blocker if any. I attached the working timeline and OKR snapshot to help — see attachments. I also posted the current QBR folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/atlas-qbr-2027

Attachments: [Attachment: QBR_prep_timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet)], [Attachment: OKR_snapshot_Project_Atlas.csv (csv)]

Irene

Adding technical gate detail from infra/ops side — owner: Karthik Iyer (Infra). Status: Green/Amber -> leaning Green after the following tasks complete: 

- Autoscale policy tweak (INF-1428) to allow burst capacity for first 72h post-release. ETA: 2027-06-07 EOD.
- Canary routing: we will run a staged canary 1 -> 10 -> 25% traffic over 48h; will need a fallback policy in the runbook (assigned to Laura).
- Metrics: latency P95 and error-rate alert thresholds are in the Jira ticket: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-1428

Blocker: small dependency on a third-party model quantization script (vendor deliverable). I will include mitigation steps in the runbook. Attaching a short Ops checklist.
